newsitem.title: USA: Affymetrix names Edward Hurwitz CFO.
newsitem.headline: Affymetrix names Edward Hurwitz CFO.

text.p: Affymetrix Inc said Wednesday that Edward Hurwitz will join the company as chief financial officer in May 1997.
In a release Wednesday, the company said Hurwitz will direct financial operations including accounting, treasury, investor relations and financial planning.
Hurwitz previously served as a senior biotechnology analyst at Robertson Stephens & Co and at Smith Barney Shearson. Prior to that, Hurwitz was an attorney, Affymetrix said in the release.
The release did not mention a previous CFO, and the company was not immediately available for comment.
